sentences.text:
For Respondent/State : Mr. Mayur Khandelwal, Panel Lawyer Hon'ble Shri Justice Ravindra Kumar
Agrawal Order on Board 12/12/2024
1.
This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail.

The applicant has been arrested in connection with Crime No. 41 of 2024, registered at Police Station Khadgawan, District Koriya (Now Manendragarh-Chirmiri-Bharatpur, Chhattisgarh for the offence under Sections 363, 366,
376(2)(n)) of IPC and Sections 4 and 6 of Protection VEDPRAKASH DEWANGAN of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

2. The case of prosecution in brief is that, on 02.02.2024, the father of the victim lodged a missing report that his minor daughter is missing since 31.01.2024 and her whereabouts could not be traced out.
The police has registered the offence under Section 363 of IPC and started investigation.
During the investigation, on 04.02.2024, the prosecutrix came back to her house, who has been taken by her father to police station and her recovery panchnama was prepared on 06.02.2024.
After recording her statement, the other offences of Section 366 and 376(2)(n) of IPC and Sections 4 and 6 of POCSO Act have been added.
The applicant has been arrested on 07.02.2024 and charge sheet has been filed.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the prosecutrix being a major girl, having love affair with the applicant, has eloped with him on her own will.

She has not made any complaint Sukhlal vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119869005/
1 and has not raised any objection while she was being taken by the applicant.
The applicant is in jail since 07.02.2024 and final adjudication of the case will take its own time.
Therefore, he may be enlarged on bail.

4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State opposes and has submitted that from the materials collected during the investigation, the prosecutrix appears to be minor on the date of incident and she was subjected to rape by the applicant.

He would further submit that against the applicant, another offence of Crime No. 292 of 2023 at Police Station Khadgawan for the offence under Sections 452, 354, 354-B, 506, 323, 34 of IPC and Section 8 of POCSO Act have been registered.
Therefore, considering the nature of allegation in the present case as well as his criminal antecedents, he is not entitled for bail.
5. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the documents annexed with the application.

6. Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties, considering the nature of allegation and the materials collected during the investigation, further considering the age of the prosecutrix as well as the fact that the applicant is having a criminal antecedent of Crime No. 292 of 2023 registered at Police Station Khadgawan, I am not inclined to release the applicant on bail.
7. Accordingly, the present bail application is rejected.

Sd/-
(Ravindra Kumar Agrawal) Judge ved Sukhlal vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119869005/
